title: 第7章 诡异幼猫露獠牙第8章 二签馈赠现锋芒
slug: 签到玄天我成了万界守护者
content_zh:
地窖里的酒坛炸得干脆利落，星河虚影散去后，只剩一地湿漉漉的符文残迹。
方浩蹲在原地，盯着那把锈钥匙，眉头都没皱一下。
“看来今晚吃不上烤鱼了。”
他嘀咕着，顺手把钥匙塞进怀里，“系统这波发的不是福利，是加班通知。”
黑猫蹲在石阶上，尾巴卷着半片贝壳，懒洋洋舔爪子，仿佛刚才那场星图共鸣跟它毫无关系。
方浩站起身，拍了拍裤腿上的灰，忽然瞥见猫嘴边一抹反光——不是口水，是金属冷光。
他眯眼，不动声色地从袖中摸出一条灵鱼，甩手扔过去。
“赏你一口。”
鱼还没落地，黑猫一爪拍飞，尾巴一甩，背过身去。
“不吃？”
方浩挑眉，“往常闻着味儿就扑上来了，今儿装起仙风道骨了？”
他慢悠悠走近，指尖凝聚一丝灵光，轻轻一弹，光晕扫过猫嘴。
那一瞬，牙缝里卡着的细小锈屑闪了一下，颜色质地，和青铜鼎腹剥落的那层老锈一模一样。
他心头一跳。
“好家伙，你啃我鼎还留案底？”
记忆猛地回溯——三个月前，这猫刚来那会儿，半夜偷啃鼎脚，被他一瓢冷水泼醒，当时还当它是馋铁吃。
可现在看来，那不是啃，是……补？
他盯着黑猫的爪子。
猫正若无其事地磨爪，爪垫按在石阶上，留下几道淡金色划痕，转瞬即逝。
“你这猫，怕不是个修文物的？”

黑猫甩了甩耳朵，跳上鼎沿，尾巴一扫，像是在清灰。
方浩没动，只把灵识悄悄铺开，缠上鼎壁。
那锈迹剥落的位置，灵纹走向竟比他记忆中多了半圈回旋，像是被人偷偷改了图纸。
他不动声色地掏出一根狗尾巴草，在鼎口晃了晃：“来，给你个新玩具。”
草尖刚碰鼎壁，黑猫耳朵一抖，忽然暴起，后腿一蹬，直扑鼎心。
“卧槽！”
方浩往后一仰，“你跳坟呢？”
猫在空中划出一道弧线，利爪狠狠抓向鼎内壁。
没有声响，可方浩的灵识却猛地一震——那爪痕亮了。
不是反光，是自发光。
三道弯曲刻痕，首尾不接，纹路不似符箓，也不像阵图，倒像是谁用指甲在墙上划出的涂鸦。
可就在那光痕浮现的瞬间，他怀里那坛星图酒的残液突然轻轻一颤，酒渍边缘泛起微光，竟与刻痕产生了共鸣。
“你……还会联动？”
方浩声音发干。
黑猫落地，四爪轻点，正踩在刻痕投影的中心。
它仰头，冲着鼎口嘶鸣一声——不是猫叫，更像某种古老钟声的余震。
刹那间，鼎内星尘翻涌，原本沉寂的七星纹路猛地一亮，北斗第七星炽如烈日。
其余六星则如风中残烛，忽明忽暗。
content_en:
The wine jar in the cellar exploded cleanly, and after the shadow of the galaxy dispersed, only the wet rune remnants were left on the ground.
Fang Hao squatted on the spot, staring at the rusty key without even frowning.
"Looks like we won't be able to eat grilled fish tonight."
He muttered and stuffed the keys into his arms, "The system is not issuing benefits this time, it's overtime notices."
The black cat squatted on the stone steps, with half a shell wrapped around its tail, lazily licking its paws, as if the star map resonance just now had nothing to do with it.
Fang Hao stood up, patted the dust on his trouser legs, and suddenly caught a glimpse of a reflection on the cat's mouth - not saliva, but a cold metallic light.
He narrowed his eyes, calmly took out a spiritual fish from his sleeve, and threw it over.
"I'll give you a bite."
Before the fish landed, the black cat slapped it away with its paw, flicked its tail, and turned its back.
"Don't eat?"
Fang Hao raised his eyebrows, "I usually pounce on you when I smell the smell, but now I'm pretending to be an immortal?"
He walked closer slowly, a trace of spiritual light condensed on his fingertips, and with a flick, the halo swept across the cat's mouth.
At that moment, the tiny rust chips stuck in the teeth flashed. The color and texture were exactly the same as the layer of old rust peeling off the belly of the bronze tripod.
His heart skipped a beat.
"Good guy, you chewed on my cauldron and you still get a criminal record?"
The memory flashed back - three months ago, when the cat first came here, he nibbled on the tripod's feet in the middle of the night and was awakened by him pouring a ladle of cold water on it. At that time, he thought it was greedy for iron.
But now it seems that it is not chewing, but...filling?
He stared at the black cat's paws.
The cat was grinding its claws as if nothing had happened. The pads of its claws pressed against the stone steps, leaving a few pale golden scratches that disappeared in an instant.
"You cat, are you not a cultural relic collector?"
The black cat flicked its ears, jumped onto the edge of the cauldron, and swept its tail as if cleaning away the dust.
Fang Hao didn't move, he just spread his spiritual consciousness quietly and wrapped it around the cauldron wall.
Where the rust was peeling off, the direction of the spiritual pattern was half a circle longer than what he remembered, as if someone had secretly changed the drawing.
He calmly took out a piece of dogtail grass and shook it at the mouth of the tripod: "Here, I'll give you a new toy."
As soon as the tip of the grass touched the cauldron wall, the black cat's ears twitched and suddenly stood up. It kicked off its hind legs and rushed towards the center of the cauldron.
"Fuck!"
Fang Hao leaned back, "Are you jumping to the grave?"
The cat drew an arc in the air and clawed hard at the inner wall of the cauldron.
There was no sound, but Fang Hao's spiritual consciousness suddenly shook - the claw marks lit up.
It's not reflective, it's self-illuminating.
The three curved carvings are not connected at the beginning and end. The pattern does not look like a talisman or a formation diagram, but rather like the graffiti that someone scratched on the wall with their fingernails.
But at the moment when the light mark appeared, the remaining liquid of the jar of Star Chart wine in his arms suddenly trembled slightly, and a shimmer appeared on the edge of the wine stain, which actually resonated with the mark.
"You...can still link up?"
Fang Hao's voice was dry.
The black cat landed on the ground, tapped its four claws, and stepped on the center of the notch projection.
It raised its head and hissed at the mouth of the tripod - not a cat's meow, but more like the aftershock of some ancient bell.
In an instant, stardust surged in the cauldron, and the seven-star lines that had been silent suddenly lit up, and the Seventh Star of the Big Dipper was as blazing as the scorching sun.
The other six stars are like candles in the wind, flickering bright and dim.
